releases.notes: 迁到 TS 构建管线 + @aibox/applet-sdk，运行形态改为构建型（端上不再转译）。封面改走 applet:// 图片代理（原来是把整张图 base64 塞进 JS 内存，比原图还大三分之一，列表一长必然吃满内存）。

localizedNotes.en: Migrated to the TS build pipeline and @aibox/applet-sdk. Artwork now streams through the applet:// image proxy instead of being inlined as base64 data URLs.

releases.notes: 子页栈与行手势改用框架资产 aibox/ui 的 useSubpageStack / useRowGestures（删除本地 lib/subpages.js、lib/gestures.js 副本）；AI 动作 id 改为下划线式

localizedNotes.en: Subpage stack and row gestures now use useSubpageStack / useRowGestures from aibox/ui (local copies removed); AI action ids switched to snake_case

releases.notes: 迷你播放条改用宿主悬浮层（aibox.overlay）：与底栏叠进同一层，不再被底栏压住；移除底部搜索胶囊，设备底边交还底栏；队列与搜索结果的长按/滑动改走原生手势（aibox.list.*）；曲目菜单补上「加入资料库」「加入歌单」。

localizedNotes.en: The mini player now uses the host overlay layer (aibox.overlay), stacked with the tab bar instead of hidden behind it; the bottom search field is gone so the tab bar owns the device edge; queue and search rows use native context menus and swipe actions (aibox.list.*); track menu gains Add to Library and Add to Playlist.

releases.notes: 本地资料库改用框架级虚拟列表 aibox/ui，删除内联的固定行高实现

localizedNotes.en: Switch the local library list to the framework VirtualList from aibox/ui and drop the inline fixed-height implementation

releases.notes: 新增 .tests.json 回归套件（smoke 覆盖外壳与降级，engine 覆盖真实播放引擎数据面）

localizedNotes.en: Add a .tests.json regression suite: smoke covers the shell and its degradation, engine covers the real playback engine data path

releases.notes: 子页导航改用系统原生页栈：设置/音效/专辑详情左滑返回时实时透出上一页、可中途放弃，不再直接退出整个小应用；修复顶栏出现两个 ⋯（more 补 role:hostMenu，自绘菜单整体迁进 scene.menu，右上角改用系统原生菜单）；tabs.changed 现在消费 rendered。

localizedNotes.en: Subpages now mirror into the host's native page stack: swiping back from settings, effects or an album reveals the previous page live and can be abandoned mid-drag, instead of dismissing the whole applet. Fixes the duplicated ⋯ in the navigation bar (more is now role:hostMenu and the web menu moved into scene.menu, so the overflow menu is a real system menu), and tabs.changed now consumes rendered.

releases.notes: 首个版本：1:1 复刻原生音乐播放器
